q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this systematically.

## (a) Time left until resolution

Today is 2026-08-21. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release occurred on May 20, 2026 (per the research), which means this event has **already happened**. The forward guidance of $91.0 billion ±2% was issued on that date. Resolution should be based on what NVIDIA actually guided for Q2 FY2027 at that earnings call.

## (b) Most likely outcome and why

The research provides explicit, dated information from NVIDIA's official investor relations materials: **$91.0 billion ±2%**, which translates to a range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion.

Since this guidance was issued on May 20, 2026, and we're now at August 21, 2026, NVIDIA has already made this forward guidance public. The question asks what "will be" their guidance, but this is asking about a past event from the perspective of the question's current date.

The most likely outcome is the **central guidance figure of $91.0 billion**, since that's what management explicitly guided to.

## (c) What would push the value lower?

Given this is asking about actual guidance already issued:
- If the question resolves on what was actually guided (not what was beat/missed), it must be $91.0B
- Any lower interpretation would require misreading the official guidance range

## (d) What would push the value higher?

Similarly, any higher figure would contradict the explicit official guidance of $91.0B ±2%.

## (e) Base rate or historical reference values

The research explicitly states: "NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**" from investor.nvidia.com. This is the authoritative source.

The guidance range is $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion, with the midpoint at $91.0 billion.

- 50th percentile (median): $91.0B (the central guidance)
- 90th percentile (upper tail): ~$92.8B (the upper bound of guidance)

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 revenue, issued on May 20, 2026, is **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%** [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). This guidance implies a range between approximately $89.2 billion and $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/).

The company's Q1 FY2027 revenue was $81.6 billion, up 20% sequentially [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/). The Q2 FY2027 outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).

Wall Street analysts currently have an average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue at around $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), which falls within NVIDIA's provided guidance range [hudson-labs.com](https://www.hudson-labs.com/research/nvidia-q2-2027-earnings-preview-nvda-revenue-guidance-key-factors).
